## Dimorphos’s Orbit Continued to Change After DART’s Impact

Before the impact, Dimorphos took 11 hours and 55 minutes to orbit the larger asteroid Didymos. Immediately afterward, its orbital period was 11 hours, 22 minutes and 37 seconds.

Over the following weeks, Dimorphos lost more rocky material to space as its orbital period continued to shorten. The period eventually settled at 11 hours, 22 minutes and 3 seconds. After the impact, Dimorphos’s orbit was also no longer circular.
